integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically. The supplemental numerical checker tests identities and finite samples only and is not used as proof. Related fixed-argument incomplete-beta and F-distribution curvature results were compared at the statement level.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical local-minimum sequence at the moving cutoff r/(n+r+1); it does not claim higher-order finite-difference signs, continuous-index concavity, or analogous statements for arbitrary beta cutoffs.
title: Strict concavity of the Chvátal negative-binomial local-minimum sequence
